aboutDialog.updateCurrent: Moji Plus {{version}} is up to date.
aboutDialog.whyNameBody: Moji Plus keeps the name of the original Moji—short, easy to remember, and evocative of characters and writing—and adds “Plus” for the changes it maintains on top of it.
aboutDialog.upstreamBody: Moji Plus is a derivative of Moji by Alex Ishida, distributed under the MIT Licence. It keeps receiving the changes made to the original project and adds its own, maintained independently.

update.availableBody: Moji Plus {{version}} is ready to download on GitHub Releases.

externalChange.modifiedBody: ‘{{name}}’ was changed outside Moji Plus, and it has unsaved changes here. Reload discards your changes; Save As keeps both versions.
externalChange.deletedBody: ‘{{name}}’ was deleted or moved outside Moji Plus. Save to recreate it, or save it under a new name.
externalChange.conflictBody: ‘{{name}}’ was changed in another app since you opened it. Replacing it discards those changes.
externalChange.reloaded: ‘{{name}}’ was updated with the version on disk.
